subject.title: Control UI: Pinned context panel for user-defined persistent facts

question: Should pinned user facts be a first-party Control UI memory feature now, folded into broader memory-file editing, or deferred until Control UI plugin contribution slots define the panel seam?
rationale: The request changes persistent prompt context and sensitive user-data behavior, while current code only supports raw allowlisted file editing and read-only workspace browsing.

options.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
options.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen semantics, diff-preview behavior, authorization, and injection precedence before implementation.

options.title: Fold into memory panel
options.body: Treat the first implementation as part of a broader MEMORY.md/USER.md memory editor if maintainers want raw memory editing to own the UX.

options.title: Defer to plugin panel seam
options.body: Wait for the Control UI contribution-slot direction if maintainers want memory and context panels to be plugin-contributed rather than bespoke core UI.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical pinned-facts design
recommendation.body: Use this issue to settle pinned-fact storage, always-injected versus last-seen semantics, diff-preview behavior, authorization, and injection precedence before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses gateway file APIs, Control UI UX, and security-sensitive persistent context behavior; steipete has adjacent history in the agent file API boundary.
